description: List payments with optional filters. Returns a paginated slice — use starting_after / ending_before cursors for the next page. Handy for reconciliation and dashboards.

created_after.description: Cursor — return items created after this payment id (payment_xxx)

created_before.description: Cursor — return items created before this payment id (payment_xxx)

ending_before.description: Legacy cursor alias (return items before this id)

group.description: Group payments by group_payment id when true

starting_after.description: Legacy cursor alias (return items after this id)

name: list_payments
